name: clover-vscode-provider
displayName: Clover — VS Code Language Model Provider
description: Adds Clover (7-Layer Neuro-Symbolic, Compiler-Verified & Memory-Accumulating System) directly to the VS Code Chat & Agent model picker.

clover.endpointUrl.description: Endpoint URL for the Clover AI System OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions server.

enumDescriptions: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (120B-A12B Hybrid Mamba-2 + Latent ReLU² MoE + NoPE GQA + C-RADIO + 2-Layer Native MTP, 1M context)
Liquid AI LFM3-1.7B (24-Layer Tri-Hybrid Width-7 Gated ShortConv + Sliding/Full GQA, 1M session context)
MoonshotAI Kimi K3 (93-Layer 2.78T MoE + MoonViT3d + DSpark, 1M session context)
clover.defaultModel.description: Default Layer-1 foundation model backbone used when a generic Clover model ID is requested.

clover.apiKey.description: Optional API key for private Clover AI System deployments.

clover.candidates.description: Number of parallel NCM Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) candidates to decode per window.

clover.requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Clover chat and agent tool-calling turns.
